name: Chetla
why: Chetla Agrani is on the doorstep and confirmed open with visitor posts; Suruchi Sangha (New Alipore, ~6 min) is the most-discussed South pandal of 2026; 66 Pally, Badamtala and Mudiali are the big-theme Kalighat/Tollygunge cluster a local walks next.

name: Gariahat
why: Ekdalia Evergreen and Singhi Park are the two marquee pandals within a few minutes' walk of Gariahat crossing; Ballygunge Cultural, Tridhara and Deshapriya Park are the Rashbehari-Gariahat Road circuit next door. Gariahat Sarbojanin Durgotsab, now on an exact pin (Google and OSM agree within 12 m), is the namesake local pick.

name: Deshapriya Park / Rashbehari
why: Deshapriya Park and Tridhara are steps away and both 2026 headliners; Ballygunge Cultural and Maddox Square are the classic adjacent stops; Mudiali is the closest big theme across Rashbehari.

name: Behala Chowrasta
why: Behala local picks: Suruchi Sangha, Barisha Club, Behala Club, Ajeya Sanghati, plus the newly verified Behala pins Barisha Sarbojanin and Behala 11 Pally (PPG and Agamoni pins agree within 250 m). Six names because live status decides whether the confirmed-open ones or the walkable new pins rank higher.

name: Kalighat metro
why: Badamtala, Mudiali and 66 Pally are the walkable Kalighat big three; Deshapriya Park is 5 minutes east; Chetla Agrani is open and a short hop west.
